evidence.description: First symptoms: the spear leaf withers and dries and can be pulled out; the base of the spindle is rotten with a foul smell.
evidence.quote: The initial symptoms appear as withering and drying of spear leaf which comes out by pulling the spindle. The basal portion of the spindle is completely rotten emitting a foul smell.
evidence.source: ICAR-Central Plantation Crops Research Institute (ICAR-CPCRI), Kasaragod — Crop protection: integrated management of pests and diseases for the successful cultivation of coconut, arecanut and cocoa (2022-11/12), p. 1

evidence.description: Phytophthora diseases of coconut and arecanut are hard to manage in endemic areas with high rainfall (above 2000 mm).
evidence.quote: Managing the phytophthora diseases in crops like coconut and arecanut in endemic areas with high rainfall (>2000 mm) is a challenging task.
evidence.source: ICAR-Central Plantation Crops Research Institute (ICAR-CPCRI), Kasaragod — Crop protection: integrated management of pests and diseases for the successful cultivation of coconut, arecanut and cocoa (2022-11/12), p. 2

management: Destroy the rotten portion of the crown and affected nuts; field sanitation reduces the build-up of the pathogen in the plantation.
Improve drainage and use wider spacing to reduce humidity in the plantation.
ICAR-CPCRI describes Trichoderma harzianum cakes as well proven for managing bud rot.
precautions: Inspect palms regularly so that spear-leaf and crown symptoms are noticed early, and have suspected palms confirmed by an agricultural officer or KVK.

Confirm the disease and any chemical use with a qualified agricultural officer or your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK). Follow the product label and local regulations; NutriPalm does not set pesticide doses.

evidence.description: ICAR-CPCRI: before monsoon onset in endemic areas, spray 1% Bordeaux mixture, once more after 45 days, and again if the rains are prolonged.
evidence.quote: It is important to adopt prophylactic treatment in disease endemic areas before the onset of monsoon by spraying 1% Bordeaux mixture and one more spray after 45 days. If the rainy period is extended, one more spray is also required.
evidence.source: ICAR-Central Plantation Crops Research Institute (ICAR-CPCRI), Kasaragod — Crop protection: integrated management of pests and diseases for the successful cultivation of coconut, arecanut and cocoa (2022-11/12), p. 2

chemical_management.message: Recommended by the cited institute but NOT label-verified by NutriPalm. Treat this as information to discuss with an agricultural officer, not as a dose.
chemical_management.reported_recommendation: ICAR-Central Plantation Crops Research Institute (ICAR-CPCRI) reports: concentration 1%; spraying; prophylactic, before the onset of monsoon; one more spray after 45 days; one more if the rainy period is extended; for Phytophthora diseases in endemic areas.

treatment.referral: Confirm the disease and any chemical use with a qualified agricultural officer or your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK). Follow the product label and local regulations; NutriPalm does not set pesticide doses.

evidence.description: ICAR-CPCRI states that regular monitoring for early diagnosis of pests and diseases is indispensable.
evidence.quote: Regular monitoring for early diagnosis of pests and diseases and integrated pest and disease management strategies are indispensable.
evidence.source: ICAR-Central Plantation Crops Research Institute (ICAR-CPCRI), Kasaragod — Crop protection: integrated management of pests and diseases for the successful cultivation of coconut, arecanut and cocoa (2022-11/12), p. 1

steps.text: Inspect palms regularly so that spear-leaf and crown symptoms are noticed early, and have suspected palms confirmed by an agricultural officer or KVK.

evidence.description: The rotten portion of the crown and affected nuts should be destroyed (field sanitation).
evidence.quote: The rotten portion of the crown, fall, affected nuts, cocoa pods, etc. should be destroyed.
evidence.source: ICAR-Central Plantation Crops Research Institute (ICAR-CPCRI), Kasaragod — Crop protection: integrated management of pests and diseases for the successful cultivation of coconut, arecanut and cocoa (2022-11/12), p. 2

evidence.description: Field sanitation reduces inoculum build-up and checks spread.
evidence.quote: Field sanitation would reduce the inoculum build-up in the plantations and check the spread of the disease.
evidence.source: ICAR-Central Plantation Crops Research Institute (ICAR-CPCRI), Kasaragod — Crop protection: integrated management of pests and diseases for the successful cultivation of coconut, arecanut and cocoa (2022-11/12), p. 2

steps.text: Destroy the rotten portion of the crown and affected nuts; field sanitation reduces the build-up of the pathogen in the plantation.

evidence.description: Improved drainage and wider spacing help reduce relative humidity.
evidence.quote: Improved drainage and wider spacing will help in reducing the relative humidity.
evidence.source: ICAR-Central Plantation Crops Research Institute (ICAR-CPCRI), Kasaragod — Crop protection: integrated management of pests and diseases for the successful cultivation of coconut, arecanut and cocoa (2022-11/12), p. 2

steps.text: Improve drainage and use wider spacing to reduce humidity in the plantation.

evidence.description: T. harzianum cakes are described as well proven for managing bud rot.
evidence.quote: Use of Trichoderma harzianum for the bio-suppression of basal stem rot and stem bleeding diseases and T. harzianum cakes for the management of bud rot disease is well proven.
evidence.source: ICAR-Central Plantation Crops Research Institute (ICAR-CPCRI), Kasaragod — Crop protection: integrated management of pests and diseases for the successful cultivation of coconut, arecanut and cocoa (2022-11/12), p. 6

steps.text: ICAR-CPCRI describes Trichoderma harzianum cakes as well proven for managing bud rot.
